Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
The Events page and Week of Nightmares page have both been updated
with the tentative schedule of events. If you'd like to run something
special (a variant, perhaps) during the WoN or Championship Weekend,
email me and we'll see what we can work out.

The schedule is just jam packed with V:TES playing but if any of you
are coming in during the first few days of the week and you want to
see something in particular (Hollywood Walk of Fame, Hollywood and
Highland, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, Venice Beach, etc.) send me an
email. Depending on the amount of interest and available
transportation, we may be able assist putting the interested parties
together with those can drive to these attractions. You should
probably also mention what day you are coming in and what event(s) you
are willing to forgo in order to see these places.

http://nac.vtesinla.org/

-Robert

Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
Hmmm. I posted this last night but it never showed up.

Okay, the tentative Week of Nightmares and Championship Weekend event
schedules have been posted. If you would like to see any particular
limited formats or variants played, please discuss here and we'll
gauge interest. If you are interested in running one of these types of
events, even better!

Our goal is simply to play tons of V:TES. However, if there are some
of you interested in seeing some of the touristy stuff, post here or
email me and I'll see if we can help put the people with cars in touch
with you. Otherwise, we're content to play that stuff by ear during
the WoN. If there's interest and transportation, we can just bolt and
go to Hollywood or the beach or whatever you've got in mind.

http://nac.vtesinla.org

-Robert
